prompt: A credit card carries a balance of $3,200 at 21.99% APR. Each month, interest of one-twelfth of the APR is added to the balance, and then a payment of $150 is made; no new purchases are made, and the last payment just clears what is left. What is the interest charged in the first month, the balance after the first payment, the number of monthly payments needed, the size of the last payment, and the total interest paid?

Coffee beans cost $11.99 for a 340 g bag or $34.80 for a 1.2 kg bag. Each cup uses 16 g of beans, and a household brews 3 cups a day over a 30-day month. What is the price per kilogram of each bag, the bean cost per cup with each bag, and how much a month is saved by using the larger bag, counting only the beans actually used?

expected_numbers.name: monthly saving with the larger bag

prompt: A shop buys headphones at $42.00 each, plus $3.50 per unit for shipping. It prices them so that profit is 40% of the selling price, rounded to the cent. In a sale it takes 25% off that price. What is the landed cost per unit, the regular selling price, the sale price, the profit per unit at the sale price, and the regular markup as a percentage of landed cost?

expected_numbers.name: profit per unit at the sale price

prompt: A contract job pays $38 an hour for 37.5 hours a week, and the contractor expects to work 48 weeks a year with no pay for the other weeks. The contractor would also pay $410 a month for health insurance. A salaried job pays $68,500 a year with insurance included. Ignoring taxes, how many hours a year would the contractor work, what is the yearly contract income, what does insurance cost per year, by how much does the salaried job come out ahead after insurance, and what hourly rate would make the two jobs equal?

expected_numbers.name: hourly rate that makes them equal

prompt: Six bookcases each need five shelves cut to 0.85 m. Boards are sold in 2.7 m lengths at $18.40 each, every board is cut into as many 0.85 m pieces as fit, and offcuts are not joined. Sales tax is 7% of the board cost. How many shelves are needed, how many boards must be bought, how many metres of offcut are left over, and what do the boards cost before and after tax?

A runner finishes a 10 km race in 52 minutes 30 seconds. For a half marathon of 21.0975 km, the plan is for each kilometre to take 5% longer than at that race pace. What is the race pace in decimal minutes per kilometre, the race speed in km/h, the half-marathon pace in decimal minutes per kilometre, and the predicted half-marathon time in minutes and in hours?

A house is bought for $385,000 with a 15% down payment, and the rest is borrowed. Closing costs are 2.8% of the purchase price and are paid in cash at closing along with the down payment. Annual property tax is 1.15% of the assessed value, which is 90% of the purchase price, and is collected in 12 equal monthly amounts. What are the down payment, the loan amount, the closing costs, the total cash needed at closing, and the monthly property tax amount?

A 4-day car rental can be booked two ways: plan A costs $49 a day with 200 free km per rental day, pooled over the whole rental, and $0.22 for each extra km; plan B costs $72 a day with unlimited km. The trip covers 1,150 km, and fuel and insurance cost the same either way. How many extra km would plan A charge for, what is that extra charge, what does each plan cost in total, and at what total distance would the two plans cost the same?

expected_numbers.name: extra km charged under plan A
distance where the plans cost the same (km)

prompt: A lawn is a 14 m by 9 m rectangle with a 6 m by 3.5 m patio cut out of one corner. Fertilizer is spread at 25 g per square metre at weeks 0, 6, 12 and 18 of the season, and it is sold in 2.5 kg bags at $13.90 each, whole bags only. What is the lawn area, how many kilograms go on per application and over the season, how many bags are needed, and what do they cost?

$40,000 is invested for 15 years in a fund that earns 6.5% a year before fees and charges an annual fee of 0.85%, so the net return is 5.65% a year, compounded annually. What would the investment be worth after 15 years with no fee, what is it worth with the fee, how much do the fees cost in lost value, what is the gain after fees, and what percentage of the no-fee gain do the fees take away?

expected_numbers.name: value after 15 years with no fee
value after 15 years with the fee
share of the no-fee gain lost to fees (%)
